verdict.rationale: sevDesk documents automatic booking-category suggestions, which is the core of the story. The claim sits alongside receipt-upload copy, so it is not clearly tied to imported bank transactions, and nothing in the evidence says the suggestions learn from user corrections. Missing for 10: explicit application of suggestions to imported bank transactions, evidence of learning from user corrections, in-depth documentation, independent or hands-on corroboration.

support.subject: As a founder, I can get automatic categorization suggestions for imported transactions that learn from my corrections

citations.quote: Receive a suggestion for the right booking category automatically.
